svg.text: Box 1 low voltage, Box 2 high voltage, Box 3 Tesla Wall Connector. A dot means connected; wires that cross without a dot are not.
Box 1: low voltage (3.3 V / 5 V / RS-485)
L1 L2 L3 N switched by -K1,
be fed after the carport RCD -Q1
U = UEXT pin, E1 / E2 = EXT1 / EXT2 pin
Cable A to Box 2: 2 × 2 twisted pair
Cable B: twisted pair, shield on X1:7 only
